What is Travellers’ Choice?

Tripadvisor gives a Travellers’ Choice award to accommodations, attractions and restaurants that consistently earn great reviews from travellers and are ranked within the top 10% of properties on Tripadvisor.
Bronze statue of Xuanzang Sanzang in the south square of the Great Wild Geese Pagoda.

Xuanzang Sanzang was a high priest of the Tang Dynasty who left the Tang capital of Chang'an at the age of 27 in search of Buddhist scriptures that had not yet been introduced to China at that time and toured the western regions and India for over 17 years, bringing back Buddhist scriptures, sariras and statues of Buddha.
He took this picture against the backdrop of the Great Wild Geese Pagoda, which he built to contain Buddhist scriptures and other works.
It seems to be a popular spot for commemorative photos.
Like the description I guess, this is a statue by the pagoda in a pretty cool little area.
A quick visit will suffice, but prepare to be overwhelmed by selfie sticks and posing!
At the moment the pagoda is covered, so perhaps the selfie statues are slightly more popular!
Be sure to walk down the strip with the huts - lots of interesting things in these to see!
